authorized_scope: 2026-10-27: rebuild the dataset for contextual memory, skill retrieval, coding/tools and feedback-based refinement; publish to HF; retain only new compliant data in the active release
legacy_policy: Preserve history and immutable local receipts; exclude legacy one-million-token rows from the active v2 configs. New v2 adapters replace v1-only publication gates for the new schema, with equivalent exact-mask, causal-input, budget and remote-readback gates.

reference_data.core_sft_2605_samples: >15M; 1B core SFT release, not a verified exact 2B mixture
reference_data.use: design and scale reference only; no rehosting of restricted UltraData artifacts

size_policy: Process all rows in the pinned, selected permitted source files. Publish every row passing the specified gates, not an arbitrary count cutoff. Report episodes, root families, assistant targets and measured tokens separately. Do not count alternate memory placements as independent tasks.

context_policy.memory_placement: deterministic front or back of the question, always before the target; chronological tool observations available only after their calls

quality_policy: no old held jobs or local benchmark questions
both native-model and Pangolin budget validation
full local export reread and pinned public readback
quality_limitations: Imported targets retain upstream provenance. Structural/rubric acceptance is not fresh semantic or environment-execution verification. Wrong or invalid explicitly flagged assistant turns are masked; a valid diagnostic call is not masked just because its result reports failure.

evaluation_plan.status: data and harness checks only; no model training
conditions: skill plus memory plus actual verifier feedback
evaluation_plan.leakage_scope: pinned local benchmark files plus known upstream evaluation-source exclusions; no universal contamination-free claim

completion: Selected source pools completely accounted for; accepted new data, token views, source notices, tested harness, full audit and Traditional Chinese report published and anonymously readable. Model efficacy remains unmeasured until separately trained/evaluated.
